headline: Your Termii waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing banks, fintechs, and payment platforms into the right Termii delivery offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Bankole Adigun.
productSummary: Termii is an AI-native CPaaS / communications platform that guarantees delivery of OTPs, payment alerts, fraud checks, and transactional signals across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email. Products: Signals (score / route / send in <50ms), Engage (AI-powered campaigns across SMS, WhatsApp, email), Resolve (shared inbox across WhatsApp, email, live chat, Instagram, Messenger). Intelligence layer Ayla is trained on 3B+ real transaction signals. Homepage proof: 3B+ transactions processed, 190+ countries, 99.9% uptime SLA, free to start. Named customers on-site: Chipper Cash (4M active users, 7 African countries, 80,000 daily transactions), Umba, Paystack, Moniepoint, Wema Bank, PiggyVest, Branch, Payaza, ByteDance. Sells to banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, and modern enterprises. HQ San Jose + Lagos.
coreInsight: Bankole already sells guaranteed multi-channel delivery so regulated platforms stop losing logins, checkouts, and fraud alerts when a single channel fails. The one list is banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, and consumer apps that send OTPs or transactional alerts. The one routing signal is how messaging infrastructure already shows up on their stack or site (BuiltWith + homepage scrape: named competitor CPaaS, OTP/verify pages with no named CPaaS, transactional-messaging language with no OTP surface, or none). Vertical labels are merge tags after routing, not a second waterfall.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is how messaging infrastructure already shows up on their stack or site
sections.takeaway: A homepage plus BuiltWith already names a competitor CPaaS, an OTP/verify page with no named CPaaS, transactional-messaging language with no OTP surface, or none of those. That page-state is stronger than a title guess, and it is free to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every bank, fintech, and payment platform
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Named competitor CPaaS goes first, then OTP/verify with no named CPaaS, then transactional alerts with no OTP surface, then every remaining in-TAM sender.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each messaging page-state gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Competitor CPaaS gets a Delivery-Confidence Switch Brief. OTP with no named provider gets a Failover Path Brief. Alerts with no OTP surface get a Multi-Channel Alerts Brief. The rest get the Transaction Signals Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Switch the single CPaaS, add failover, put alerts on more than one channel, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always in-TAM banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, and consumer apps that send OTPs or transactional alerts, aimed at engineering, product, and fraud/risk titles. Vertical is a merge tag, not a second TAM. A/Bs sit on the exclusive routes.

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the messaging state already on their stack or site
sections.takeaway: Notice the named CPaaS, the OTP page, or the alerts line, poke the single-channel login or checkout gap that page-state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the competitor-CPaaS route first
sections.takeaway: Start where they already pay a messaging provider and still lose logins when that one path fails. Prove reply density, then roll OTP-with-no-provider, alerts-with-no-OTP, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: LinkedIn plus bank, fintech, and payments directories are the TAM Bankole already named: banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, and consumer apps that send OTPs or transactional alerts.

The same BuiltWith plus homepage scrape returns a named competitor CPaaS (Twilio, Infobip, Vonage/Nexmo, Bird/MessageBird, Africa's Talking, Sinch, Plivo), an OTP/verify page with no named CPaaS, or transactional-messaging language with no OTP surface, which is enough to route without a second enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live Termii positioning: guaranteed multi-channel delivery of OTPs, payment alerts, and fraud checks; Signals score / route / send in <50ms; 99.9% uptime SLA; 3B+ transactions; 190+ countries; free to start (all on termii.com).
Vertical labels are scrape filters and merge tags. They are not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last, never the TAM spine.

sources.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator company + title graph
sources.delivers: In-TAM banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, and consumer apps plus engineering / product / fraud / risk titles. The TAM gate.

sources.name: Homepage and product-page scrape
sources.delivers: messaging_page_state used to assign Tier 1 / 2 / 3 / catch-all: named competitor CPaaS, OTP/verify with no named CPaaS, transactional-messaging language with no OTP surface, or none. One pull.

sources.name: BuiltWith / script and footer scan
sources.delivers: Named competitor CPaaS (Twilio, Infobip, Vonage/Nexmo, Bird/MessageBird, Africa's Talking, Sinch, Plivo) when the scrape needs a second pass

sources.name: Bank / fintech / payments directories (optional)
sources.delivers: Backup in_tam when LinkedIn coverage is thin. Gate only.

sources.name: Apollo (after qualification)
sources.delivers: Work emails for already-routed accounts. Do not buy a raw OTP-at-fintechs list and hope.

sources.name: Optional Termii customer suppress
sources.delivers: Current-customer exclusion when the signal is visible. Named logos on termii.com (Chipper Cash, Umba, Paystack, Moniepoint, Wema Bank, PiggyVest, Branch, Payaza, ByteDance) are not a franchise-wide exclude.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND messaging_page_state = competitor_cpaas (Twilio, Infobip, Vonage/Nexmo, Bird/MessageBird, Africa's Talking, Sinch, Plivo)
routingRules.why: They already send OTPs or transactional alerts through a named CPaaS. Strongest intent for a delivery-confidence switch when that one path fails.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND messaging_page_state = otp_no_provider (OTP/verify pages with no named CPaaS)
routingRules.why: They already run an OTP or verify surface and have no named messaging provider. Pain is failover, not education.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND messaging_page_state = alerts_no_otp (transactional-messaging language with no OTP surface)
routingRules.why: They already talk payment alerts, fraud checks, or transactional signals, but there is no OTP/verify surface. Maps to Termii's multi-channel alerts offer.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, consumer apps that send OTPs or transactional alerts). Softest CTA, broadest copy, mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Competitor CPaaS on stack or site
tiers.trigger: BuiltWith or homepage shows Twilio, Infobip, Vonage/Nexmo, Bird/MessageBird, Africa's Talking, Sinch, or Plivo
tiers.pain: They already pay a CPaaS, but OTPs, payment alerts, and fraud checks still sit on one path. Logins and checkouts die when that channel fails.
tiers.valueProp: Termii Signals scores, routes, and sends transactional signals in <50ms across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email so a single-channel outage does not take down the login.
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already pay to send transactional messages
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on termii.com

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: OTP/verify live, no named CPaaS
tiers.trigger: Site has an OTP, verify, or 2FA surface and no named competitor CPaaS
tiers.pain: The verify flow is live, but there is no named failover path, so a failed SMS OTP still blocks login and checkout.
tiers.valueProp: Guaranteed multi-channel delivery so regulated platforms stop losing logins and checkouts when one channel fails.
tiers.replyDensity: High - they already ship an OTP surface
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on termii.com

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Transactional alerts, no OTP surface
tiers.trigger: Site language names payment alerts, fraud checks, or transactional messaging, and there is no OTP/verify surface
tiers.pain: Alerts already matter and still ride a single channel, with no OTP surface to prove a failover stack.
tiers.valueProp: Multi-channel payment alerts and fraud checks across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email, with the 99.9% uptime SLA on termii.com.
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - alerts language proves transactional messaging, urgency varies
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on termii.com

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM transactional senders
tiers.trigger: In-TAM bank, fintech, payment processor, telecom, or consumer app with a messaging decision maker and no Tier 1-3 page-state
tiers.pain: OTPs or transactional alerts still leave on a single channel with no score / route / send layer.
tiers.valueProp: A simple path to Termii's AI-native CPaaS: Signals, Engage, and Resolve, with Ayla trained on 3B+ real transaction signals. Free to start (on termii.com).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn company + title graph after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM; not published on termii.com

campaigns.name: OTP is live, no named provider
campaigns.strategy: Name the {{otp_phrase}} surface on their site, poke the missing failover path, offer the Failover Path Brief.
campaigns.value: Keep login and checkout up when SMS fails
campaigns.overview: Second exclusive route. Keep copy about failover, not education.

campaigns.name: Alerts language, no OTP surface
campaigns.strategy: Lead with the {{alert_phrase}} already on their site and the missing OTP/verify surface, then the 99.9% uptime SLA already on termii.com.
campaigns.value: Put payment and fraud alerts on more than one channel
campaigns.overview: Third exclusive route. {{vertical}} is a merge tag.

campaigns.name: Remaining transactional senders

campaigns.value: Simple path to guaranteed multi-channel delivery

messages.subject: {{competitor}} on {{company_name}}
messages.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Saw {{competitor}} on your stack. Usually that means OTPs and payment alerts already go out, but login and checkout still die when that one path fails.

We put together a one-page Delivery-Confidence Switch Brief for {{vertical}} platforms: how peers score, route, and send transactional signals in <50ms across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email (Termii Signals, on termii.com).

Worth a look?

Hey {{first_name}},

Quick bump on the Switch Brief. Happy to send the one-pager if {{competitor}} is still the only delivery path on the stack.

Either way, appreciate you.

messages.subject: question for {{first_name}}
messages.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Should I close the loop on this, or is delivery confidence still something {{company_name}} wants cleaner than a single CPaaS path?

A / B / C is fine.

launchPlan: Confirm in_tam definition: banks, fintechs, payment processors, telecoms, and consumer apps that send OTPs or transactional alerts (Termii buyer set on termii.com).

Pull Sales Nav for those companies, then scrape homepages and BuiltWith for messaging_page_state. Suppress known Termii customers when the signal is visible. Named logos on termii.com are not a blanket exclude.
Launch Tier 1 only until reply density is clear (target ~1 positive / 150-300).
Add Tier 2 otp_no_provider once Tier 1 copy is stable.
Add Tier 3 alerts_no_otp, then the catch-all for remaining in-TAM senders.
Enrich emails via Apollo only after the account is routed.
A/B Switch Brief vs <50ms Signals proof on Tier 1 before cloning to lower tiers. Do not invent delivery-lift percentages that are not on termii.com.

thresholds.action: Scale the tier and clone winning angles downward
Keep running; tighten personalization on {{competitor}} or {{otp_phrase}}
Test a subject or offer variant before cutting
Cut the tier and move volume to the next exclusive route
